summary: Inspira Technologies OXY B.H.N. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a $596,000 purchase order for an Additively Manufactured Electronics (AME) system from an Irish technological university. The order includes a 40% non-refundable upfront payment (received) and balance due on delivery, with recurring revenue from consumables and service fees. The company expects delivery within weeks. This is a routine product sale, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
